g.text: Compute doubles twice as fast as the money and power behind it

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: What it shows: how fast each measured quantity has doubled since 2010, fitted to the notable models that record it.

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Compute is not simply parameters multiplied by data — the three grow at visibly different rates, and the resources bought

text.style: font-size: 10.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: to produce it grow slower still.

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Source: Epoch AI, Data on AI Models (CC-BY) — notable_ai_models.csv — epoch.ai/data/ai-models

text.style: font-size: 8.6px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Methodology: Methodology reference pending final methodology document; derivation follows Epoch AI's published AI models documentation

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: Note: Each fit is an ordinary least-squares line through log10 of the metric against publication date, over exactly the models that record

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: that metric — a different subset for every bar, from 180 to 634 models, shown against each bar with its r². The r² values are low for

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: cost and power, so those two doubling times describe a wide cloud, not a tight trend. Nothing is extrapolated past the last

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 8.4px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #6b7280

g.text: observation, and no missing value is filled: a model with no recorded cost is absent from the cost fit rather than assigned one.
